specialistReviews.finding: Source-only owner/mention role logic plus local PG fixture cannot prove signed-in actor identity or direct object link fetch ACL in native Supabase.
specialistReviews.resolution: Keep partial; require native Supabase disposable actor/tenant/role negative runtime checks before release.

specialistReviews.finding: Adding unique active owner index may fail if an occupied target already contains multiple active owners.
specialistReviews.resolution: No live database writes; require read-only duplicate-owner inventory before applying outside clean rehearsal.

challenge.scenario: Existing internal thread contains two active owner participants.
challenge.finding: Partial unique owner index would fail or owner designation becomes inconsistent.
challenge.resolution: Preserve canonical owner uniqueness and require occupied-target read-only duplicate-owner inventory before rollout.

challenge.scenario: A malicious service request adds a mention of a user outside the webshop.
challenge.finding: Mention metadata could reveal private correspondence across tenants.
challenge.resolution: Use canonical composite instance/message FK, actor permissions and native authenticated negative test later.

challenge.scenario: A message attaches an order from another tenant while reusing a valid UUID.
challenge.finding: Linked business card can expose another shop commercial data.
challenge.resolution: Require private.office_chat_object_exists_v1 with instance_id predicate and real cross-tenant test.

challenge.scenario: Browser role reads office_message_mentions without corresponding access to private thread.
challenge.finding: Mention identities and private message relationships become visible through Data API.
challenge.resolution: RLS enabled and revoke all from public/anon/authenticated; actual PostgreSQL role SELECT denial and Supabase check.

challenge.scenario: Two admins concurrently grant owner on one active thread.
challenge.finding: Multiple active owners possible without DB unique constraint.
challenge.resolution: Create partial unique index for active owner scoped to instance and thread.

challenge.scenario: Support customer thread is passed into team chat group action.
challenge.finding: Internal workspace mutation can incorrectly change customer correspondence state.
challenge.resolution: Canonical RPC enforces internal_private/internal_group guards and object/membership rules.

challenge.scenario: Thread creator leaves the group and an owner transfer is requested.
challenge.finding: Foundation owner model may lack complete transfer semantics.
challenge.resolution: Keep Team Chat owner transfer as separate later migration, do not mark capability DONE.

challenge.scenario: Caller passes a forged p_actor to service_role mutator.
challenge.finding: SQL comparison to p_actor does not validate the actual authenticated caller.
challenge.resolution: Release blocked until server session-to-actor binding verified on native Supabase.
